name: Dana Hartnett
headline: Senior Director, Professional Services, Infor
about:
Self-Motivated, detail oriented, fast paced, personable individual with excellent communication skills. Extensive executive program ERP management experience with large-scale initiatives that require significant business and technical expertise and coordination. 

Skilled program and project lead experience where responsible for project schedules, issue resolution, time and scope requirements, and governance. I work well in a team environment but am also self-motivated, task driven, and strive to meet or exceed any deadlines given. Focused, analytical, driven, determined, dedicated and loyal.

Passionate Client Advocate
Process & Supply Chain Experience
25+ years direct experience with Fortune 100 ERP Distribution, logistics, automotive and supply chain software. Specialized projects leveraging Kanban, Kaizen, ITIL, LeanIT, PMI, Six Sigma principles.
Portfolio Management & Fiscal Responsibility
Over 20 years experience with large scale ERP program and project and technology portfolios with budgets up to $100 million. Proven track record of delivering service and projects on time and on budget

experiences.position: Technology Leader, SD Mgr, Director, Information Technology, JM Family Enterprises, Southeast Toyota
experiences.description:
Certified Business Relationship Management Professional, focused on orchestrating, enabling, and improving IT and business alignment with goals of creating  effective strategic partnerships and driving increased business performance.

Specializing in leadership of teams that deliver ongoing success and exceed goals.  I am passionate about technology and the power it holds to truly increase productivity, decrease costs and generate revenue.  My primary focus is to continue orchestrating strategic alignment and implementing solutions that drive business goals, making systems and associates better, faster and stronger.

o	Directed team initiative responsible for consolidation and efficiency process reengineering of over 200 productions IT tools.
o	Direct oversight of implementation of SalesForce.com implementation, including development and customization for 10 operational areas. Coordinated developers, operations, and with SalesForce executives to ensure timely and successful implementation and establishing efficiency increases.
o	Establish and deliver lower cost, more strategic technical and development initiatives to meet and exceed corporate revenue goals.
o	Complete design and direct multi-year technology plan to meet business goals and overall corporate earnings targets.  Responsible for maintaining strategic planning, oversight of technical architecture , principles & reference architecture, technology standards, conceptual patterns, detailed design patterns for revenue IT operations.
o	Oversee, motivate, and direct high performance AGILE and SCRUM development teams responsible for new implementation tools designed to drive efficiency and generate increased revenue under compressed development schedules.
o	Motivates employees to produce “next level” efforts that drive incredible results.  Foster a team culture of continuous improvement, creativity, and innovation. Set challenging and realistic goals that technical vision to meet and or exceed objectives and drive up productivity and down costs.

Responsible for data analysis and programs support.  Accountable for both technical and application support.  Ensure collaboration across business and IT segments.  Implement multiple system integrations, including oversight/ management massive data migrations

Coordinate/manage all technology related aspects of client delivery efforts.  Lead all IT support activities ensuring coordination, completion of deliverables, communication of status, and escalation/resolution of issues.

Worked with the Information Techology department in development of the employee intranet. Also worked on enhancements of the corporate website.  
Asissted the IT director on Microsoft projects.
